ess-beta-metadata.label: No qualifications
ess-beta-metadata.subtitle: Percentage of people aged 16 to 64 with no qualifications
ess-beta-metadata.longDescription: This indicator shows percentage of the population aged 16 to 64 with no qualifications, in Great Britain (Northern Ireland national figure included), for the annual periods January to December, 2022 and 2023.
ess-beta-metadata.caveats:
These estimates are derived from the Labour Force Survey (LFS) and Annual Population Survey (APS), which have moved from [Official Statistics in Development](https://osr.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/who-we-are/policies/official-statistics-policies/official-statistics-in-development/) to [Official Statistics](https://osr.statisticsauthority.gov.uk/who-we-are/policies/official-statistics-policies/official-statistics-policy/). Since late 2023, ONS has introduced improvements to survey collection, sampling and weighting methods, helping to improve response levels and data quality. Further information on the strengths, limitations and appropriate uses of these data is available in the [Labour Force Survey quality and methodology information (QMI)](https://www.ons.gov.uk/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/employmentandemployeetypes/methodologies/labourforcesurveylfsqmi).

Updates to this indicator have been temporarily suspended until the APS reweighting is implemented in 2027.
